S.what: the driver with the shipped policy
S.audit_off_entry: rodas5p_integrators::integrate_rodas5p_mf_fast_observed_gmres_into (the entry of the route; this function keeps the shipped policy after the edit)
S.audit_on_entry: Rodas5pMfFastWorkspace::new, set_gmres_into(true), set_solve_log(true), integrate_observed_with_observer (the audit entry of V17 arm A), after the edit with the policy set to shipped explicitly as well

arms.P1: the driver with the adaptive policy, upper bound of every cycle = the configured restart length (40)
arms.P2: the driver with the adaptive policy, upper bound 10 for the first cycle of a solve, 20 for the second, 40 (the configured restart length) from the third on: the bound doubles after every cycle that is followed by another cycle of the same solve
arms.N: P1 or P2 as fixed by CHOICE.json
adaptive_policy_exactly: zero start and the right-hand side norm as shipped; threshold tau = max(linear_atol, rtol_lin * ||rhs||_2), the expression of the shipped kernel

top of every pass, as shipped: the true residual of the current iterate (rhs itself for the all-zero iterate, otherwise rhs - A x with one counted operator application); if its 2-norm is at most tau the loop ends; if the budget (200 Arnoldi vectors) is used up the solve fails with the shipped error text

a cycle: Arnoldi columns with the two-pass modified Gram-Schmidt kernel of the shipped solver; after EVERY column the Givens-projected residual |g_(j+1)| of the Arnoldi relation is compared with tau; the cycle ends at the first column with |g_(j+1)| <= tau, at a happy breakdown, at the upper bound of the cycle, or when the budget is used up

the iterate of the cycle is formed once, at its end; the next pass forms its true residual and tests it against tau (the original stage residual test); if the test fails the solve continues from that iterate

after the loop: the final residual test of the shipped kernel under the residual accounting of the workspace (default RecomputeFinal: the true residual of the returned iterate is formed once more and tested against tau; a failure is the shipped error)
an iterate is returned only if its true residual is at most tau; every failure is CoreError::LinearSolve with the shipped texts, which the driver turns into a rejected attempt exactly as today
arms.residual_accounting_of_the_adaptive_arms: the default of the route (ResidualAccounting::RecomputeFinal), unchanged: the registered decision of SP01 is not overridden by this node. The adaptive arms therefore pay the duplicate final residual like the shipped arm. ReuseConfirmed with the adaptive policy is measured only as an exploratory arm.

V.audited_runs: every audit-on run of an adaptive arm: P1 and P2 on the 10 development cells, N on the 20 deciding cells, and every exploratory audit-on run. V of the frozen row is counted on N on the deciding grid; a violation in any other audited run of an adaptive arm is reported under V as well and counts as a violation.
V.check_1_independent: ProtectedAudit of stage_clients_krylov_v17_problems.rs, unchanged: in the attempt observer every stage solve the driver completed is rebuilt from the stage equations with the audit's own right-hand side and JVP; violation iff the residual norm is not finite or exceeds max(gamma atol_lin rounded down, rtol_lin ||rhs_i||_2).
V.check_2_solve_log: the driver's own record of every returned iterate (reported true residual norm and the threshold it used): violation iff the reported norm is not finite or exceeds the threshold.
V.check_3_coverage: audited solves = records of the driver = the counter linear_solves; every attempt that failed in a stage solve is counted by linear_solve_failures and classified by the kernel's error text (budget exhaustion or other). A mismatch of these counts is a violation.
V.check_4_determinism: the audit-on and the audit-off run of an arm in a cell agree in every counter and every bit of the end state; a mismatch voids the cell (V17 rule).
V.violations: sum of the violations of checks 1 to 3 over the audited runs; V holds iff it is 0 and check 4 holds in every cell.

discriminator_protocol.A: per cell E_N <= 3 E_S with E = max_i |y_i(t1) - ref_i| / (1 + |ref_i|) (V17 primary metric), both at the tolerance of the cell. A cell whose E_S is below 10 u_ref is flagged reference limited.

P.work_measure: V17 instruction measure, unchanged: perf stat -e instructions:u over the whole process of the audit-off run (the test binary called directly), minus the median of three SETUP runs of the same family with the same binary. One execution per run.
P.family_number: the family statistic of the V17 matched-error rule, unchanged (curve_value and matched of mf_stage_solve/parse_results.py, imported, not re-written): geometric mean over 201 points in log E on the matched range of W_N(E) / W_S(E), arm S in the role of arm A (smallest interpolated value), arm N in the role of the candidate (largest). P needs it <= 0.50 in each of the four families. A family with fewer than 4 completed tolerances in an arm or without an overlapping error range above 10 u_ref is NOT_DECIDABLE.
P.cell_number: per cell the candidate's interpolated work at the error arm S achieved in that cell, divided by the work of arm S in that cell (V17: 'ratio at every point of arm A inside the range'). For a cell whose S point lies outside the matched range (no extrapolation) the ratio at equal tolerance is used and the cell is labelled. P needs every cell number <= 1.00.
P.also_reported_not_deciding: the geometric mean of the five cell numbers, the geometric mean and every value of the ratio at equal tolerance, the largest ratio on the 201-point grid. If the verdict of a family or cell would differ under one of these, the report says so next to the verdict.
P.kill_clause: the frozen KILL clause 'P above 0.85 on two families' uses the family number.

discriminator_protocol.S: per family the geometric mean over the five tolerances of attempts_N / attempts_S at equal tolerance must be <= 1.05, and every one of the 20 ratios <= 1.15 (attempts = accepted + rejected). The matched-error attempts ratio is reported, not deciding. A family with a run that did not complete is NOT_DECIDABLE.
discriminator_protocol.B: per cell: budget-exhausting stage solves of N <= those of S. Counted by the driver for both policies: stage solves that ended with the kernel error 'GMRES exhausted <budget> Arnoldi vectors' (classified by that text). Reported next to linear_solve_failures; other linear failures are listed separately.

T.cell: V17 protocol with two arms: 9 rounds, each round runs S and N once, order rotated by the round index (SN, NS, ...); rounds 0 and 1 are warm-ups, rounds 2 to 8 the 7 repetitions; median and spread (max - min)/median per arm; load from /proc/loadavg read by the wrapper immediately before and after every invocation.
T.quality_rule: authoritative iff the 1-minute load is at most 8 before and after and the spread of both arms is at most 10 percent; every timed run must end in the state of the instruction run of its arm.
T.short_invocations: no invocation holds the lock for two minutes: if the two single-run walls of a cell (from the instruction runs) sum to more than 8 s the nine rounds are nine invocations of one round each with the same rotation (V17 long-cell rule with a lower limit).
T.waiting_and_repeats: at most 10 minutes of waiting for a quiet host in total; then the cells are measured as the host is. A cell that misses the rule is re-measured at most once and only if the load is at most 8 at that moment; every measurement is kept; the first one that meets the rule is used, otherwise the last one, labelled diagnostic_only.
T.status: reported per family (speed-up at matched error, V17 statistic); not part of the verdict

choice_of_the_variant.frozen_rule: the variant with the smaller geometric mean of instructions at matched achieved error on the two development problems; within 2 percent P1 is taken
choice_of_the_variant.computation: for each variant X in {P1, P2} and each development problem d: R(X, d) = the V17 family statistic of the instructions of X against the shipped arm S on d (same function as discriminator P). score(X) = sqrt(R(X, dev06_bruss1d) * R(X, dev06_adr2d)). P2 is chosen iff score(P2) < 0.98 * score(P1); otherwise P1.
choice_of_the_variant.fallback: if R(X, d) is NOT_DECIDABLE for either variant on a problem, the geometric mean over the five tolerances of the ratio at equal tolerance is used for BOTH variants on that problem and CHOICE.json says so.
choice_of_the_variant.eligibility: a variant with a V violation in a development run is not chosen; such a violation is a KILL of the node by the frozen rule and is reported as such
choice_of_the_variant.file: CHOICE.json is written by the parser from the development logs and committed before any run of an adaptive arm on the deciding grid
